Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.util

package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.util
Public utility classes for working with grids and plan type dimensions: printing and diffing data slices (GridPrinter, DataSliceDiff), walking a dimension hierarchy (PlanTypeWalker), and building test fixtures or sample connections (TextGridReader, PbcsClientUtils). Meant to be used directly by callers, not just this library's own tests.
Author:
Jason Jones

    A base class that can be extended by those implementing the Visitor interface.

    A Runnable that walks a single dimension breadth-first, visiting the dimension's root member and then its children level by level.
    PlanTypeWalker.DepthFirstDimensionProcessor
    A Runnable that walks a single dimension depth-first, fully visiting each member's descendants before moving to the next sibling.

    The result a PlanTypeWalker.Visitor returns to control whether a walk continues.

    Options controlling how a plan type is walked: which dimensions to include, the traversal order, and the degree of parallelism.
    PlanTypeWalker.TraversalType
    The order in which a dimension's members are visited.
